name: MonarchChartLegend
title: ChartLegend
wrapsNative: MonarchFlowLayout or VStackLayout of entries; with hiddenSeries, standard Toggles with a private ToggleStyle (accessibilityRepresentation)
summary: The names and colours of a chart's series in the theme's data slots, as a plain list or as toggles that show and hide each series, with a Show all reset.
whenToUse: When several charts share one legend, when the legend sits away from the plot, or when a legend needs values beside its labels.
whenNotToUse: Swift Charts draws its own legend for a single chart (chartLegend(_:)); MonarchChartFrame shows this legend for you. Not for status colours: legends name data series.
api: init(_ items: [MonarchChartLegendItem], marker: MonarchChartLegendMarker = .line, axis: Axis = .horizontal, legendLabel: String? = nil)

init(_ items: [MonarchChartLegendItem], hiddenSeries: Binding<Set<String>>, marker: MonarchChartLegendMarker = .line, axis: Axis = .horizontal, keepsOneVisible: Bool = true, showsShowAll: Bool = true, legendLabel: String? = nil, showAllLabel: String? = nil)
MonarchChartLegendItem.init(_ key: String, label: String, color: MonarchChartColor? = nil, isDashed: Bool = false, value: String? = nil)
enum MonarchChartColor { case data1, data2, data3, data4, data5, neutral }
enum MonarchChartLegendMarker { case line, square, dot }

options.name: items
options.description: The entries in series order: key, label, optional colour slot, dashed flag and value.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: The keys of hidden series. Given, every entry becomes a toggle.

options.name: axis
options.description: A row that wraps onto new rows, or a column.

options.name: keepsOneVisible
options.description: Whether the last visible series cannot be hidden.

options.name: showsShowAll
options.description: Whether a Show all button appears while one of the legend's series is hidden.

options.name: showAllLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in button title "Show all".

states.name: visible
states.description: The marker in the series colour and the label in the default text colour.

states.name: hidden
states.description: Toggles only: the marker in the disabled text colour and the label muted and struck through.

states.name: locked
states.description: The last visible series with keepsOneVisible: tapping it does nothing.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Toggles only: a muted fill behind the entry.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Set with disabled(_:). Markers and text use the disabled text colour and toggles do not respond.

appearance: Markers use the theme's categorical data roles data1 to data5 in order, and the subtle text colour for neutral. Labels are caption text in the default colour, values in the default colour with tabular digits. Hidden series use the disabled and muted text colours. The data roles are contrast-checked per theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ChartLegend is a list, or a toolbar with one Tab stop and arrow keys when toggleable, and reports the hovered entry through onActiveChange. On iOS each toggle is its own VoiceOver element and there is no hover, so onActiveChange and the toolbar keys are not offered; a locked entry ignores the tap instead of being aria-disabled. Android ships the same MonarchChartLegend.
accessibility: The legend is a container labelled "Legend" (or legendLabel).
A plain entry is one element read as the label, a comma and the value; the marker is decorative.
A toggle entry is given to VoiceOver as a standard Toggle that is on while the series is shown.
A hidden series is shown by a struck-through label and a grey marker, not by colour alone.
Toggle entries and the Show all button keep a 44-point touch target; text scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: More than five series: the sixth and later are neutral; fold them into "Other" or split the chart.
Long labels wrap; the row wraps onto new rows.
Keys in hiddenSeries that the legend does not list stay hidden after Show all, so several legends can share one set.
A locked entry gives no spoken feedback when tapped; this was not checked with VoiceOver on a device.

examples.title: Plain legend with values
examples.code:
MonarchChartLegend(
    [
        MonarchChartLegendItem("web", label: "Web", color: .data1, value: "12,480"),
        MonarchChartLegendItem("ios", label: "iOS", color: .data2, value: "8,210"),
        MonarchChartLegendItem("android", label: "Android", color: .data3, value: "6,975"),
    ],
    marker: .square
)

examples.title: Toggles that show and hide series
examples.code:
MonarchChartLegend(
    [
        MonarchChartLegendItem("web", label: "Web"),
        MonarchChartLegendItem("ios", label: "iOS"),
        MonarchChartLegendItem("android", label: "Android"),
    ],
    hiddenSeries: $hidden,
    marker: .square
)
